title: Ore regen
description: An easy to use ore regen mod with config.
body:
# Void Ore Regen — Commands

Ores mined inside a regen region turn into a placeholder block and regenerate automatically.

Aliases: `/oreregen`, `/oregen`, `/voregen`

## General

`/oreregen status` — Shows mod, region, pending, respawn, and placeholder status.
`/oreregen reload` — Reloads config and regions.
`/oreregen enable` — Enables ore regen globally.
`/oreregen disable` — Disables ore regen globally.
`/oreregen list` — Lists all regions.
`/oreregen here` — Shows the region you are standing in.

## Selection Tool

`/oreregen tool` — Gives the selector tool.
`/oreregen wand` — Same as `/oreregen tool`.

Selector tool: **Ore Regen Selector** diamond pickaxe.
Left-click block = pos1.
Right-click block = pos2.

`/oreregen selection show` — Shows the selected area with particles.
`/oreregen selection clear` — Clears your selection.

## Manual Selection

`/oreregen pos1` — Sets first corner at your position.
`/oreregen pos2` — Sets second corner at your position.

## Regions

`/oreregen region create <name>` — Creates a region using pos1/pos2.
`/oreregen region create <name> <respawnSeconds>` — Creates a region with fixed respawn time.
`/oreregen region info <name>` — Shows region info.
`/oreregen region remove <name>` — Deletes a region.
`/oreregen region enable <name>` — Enables a region.
`/oreregen region disable <name>` — Disables a region.
`/oreregen region settime <name> <respawnSeconds>` — Sets region respawn time.
`/oreregen region cleartime <name>` — Removes region respawn override.
`/oreregen region setplaceholder <name> <blockId>` — Sets region placeholder block.
`/oreregen region clearplaceholder <name>` — Removes region placeholder override.

## Region Ore List

`/oreregen region ore list <name>` — Lists region ores.
`/oreregen region ore add <name> <blockOrTag>` — Adds an ore/block tag to a region.
`/oreregen region ore remove <name> <blockOrTag>` — Removes an ore/block tag from a region.
`/oreregen region ore clear <name>` — Clears region ore list and uses global ores again.
`/oreregen region ore settime <name> <blockId> <respawnSeconds>` — Sets custom respawn time for one ore in a region.
`/oreregen region ore cleartime <name> <blockId>` — Removes custom respawn time for one ore in a region.

## Pending Ores

`/oreregen pending count` — Shows ores waiting to regenerate.
`/oreregen pending clear` — Clears saved pending ore entries. This does not replace existing placeholder blocks.

## Quick Setup

1. `/oreregen tool`
2. Left-click one corner.
3. Right-click the opposite corner.
4. `/oreregen selection show`
5. `/oreregen region create mine 300`
6. `/oreregen region info mine`
